Any devx seat may claim it. `domain:devx` is inherited from the parent.

## Scope
**Files:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/i18n.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/dashboards.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/search.json`. No other file. ⛔ No product code.

**Rows:** 21, from the seat's read-only census of every finding parked on #27377 (census note 6539602007), taken at origin/main `501c864dd5`. Re-verify each row against the current head before editing. A row that no longer holds is reported as fixed upstream.
